item.title: From shelter to Puppy Bowl: Dog born at Syracuse rescue hits the big leagues
item.description: Jessie, a rescue dog from Syracuse, is set to make her Puppy Bowl debut this Sunday after being unexpectedly born at a local shelter and later adopted by a kennel staff member's father.

item.title: Tell Me Something Good: Westhill band director to be honored at Syracuse Area Music Awards
item.description: Erin Elthen, Director of Bands at Westhill, has been named Music Educator of the Year by the Syracuse Area Music Awards for her 23-year career at the school and her leadership in developing the region's music programs.
